result.brief: 综述以 agent harness 为枢纽，串联智能体化视频生成、动作条件视频世界模型与混合引擎渲染，并讨论递归自我改进与评测挑战。
result.reason: Survey of agentic video generation and agentic world modeling via agent harnesses, covering action-conditioned predicted futures and hybrid engine-render designs, directly matching video world model interests.
